summary: HGSS port: Japanese Game Corner prize counters and text; Platinum Gen 5 work merged and installed; save editor and debug window ported to HGSS; HGSS Gen 5 battles gained naming, evolution, Apricorn Balls, trainers' mid-battle lines, a loss fix and the Safari Zone. Everything tested on the desktop (Docker) and installed on the AYN Thor, but nothing new has been tried on the Thor itself.

work.what: Japanese Game Corner prize counters (TMs/held items, Pokemon) work with the JP scripts; English text fixed (CopyU16ArrayToStringN length must include EOS) and re-wrapped to <=208 px of the 216 px box.
test_commands_added: menu event for touchscreen yes/no and lists

work.what: gen5-battles (Safari Zone, weather, partner sprites, Nuzlocke, keep moves) reviewed, merged into platinum-thor, built by Actions run 43691796942, installed as org.pokeplatinum.port 9100027.

Port of Platinum's save editor on HGSS's save APIs: party/PC (level, nature, shiny, gender, ability, item, friendship, IVs, EVs, moves, heal), give a Pokemon, .pk4 export/import, bag, trainer (money, BP, 16 badges, play time, National Dex). Left out: trade box (no save slots), Sinnoh legendary events.

ImGui window (SIM::GUI::PrjMain): warps to the 30 Fly points (named from the map each lands on) or any map/tile; trainers on the current map with Go to / Battle / Beaten; battle any trainer by number or name; wild battle by species/level. Battles follow the Gen 5 setting; lost wild battles white out.
After a Gen 5 battle: HGSS naming screen for a catch (own HEAP_ID_BATTLE heap), then evolutions via BattleSystem_CheckEvolution/EvolutionScene_New, as a state machine in the Gen 5 overlay's Main.
Debug window and test-runner wild battles now call CallTask_Blackout on a loss (HGSS's encounter task leaves a loss to its caller; before, the game was left with no overworld).

Apricorn Balls by HGSS's battle_command.c rules when Gen5Battle.apricornBalls is set (HGSS only). BW2 patches: btl_server_flow_sub.c (catch rate, Sport Ball 1.5x), pml_item.c (Poke Ball's item data for them), b_bag_item.c (battle bag pocket), btlv_effvm.c (thrown as a Poke Ball sprite). Caught ball comes back as ball id (Level=18) and is converted to the item (493); Friend Ball sets friendship 200. Gen5Battle.fishing sets BW2's fishing flag (Lure Ball).

Gen5Trainer.hintText[4]: lines at first hit, half HP, last Pokemon, last at half HP (BW2 hint ids 0x11-0x14 = HGSS TRMSG 13-16). btl_client.c and btlv_core.c patches ask the port for trainers >= 0x800. Platinum doesn't fill them yet.
BattleSetup_CopyResultsToSaveData moves a quarter of money won to Mom regardless of engine. Missing: HGSS's in-battle 'sent money to Mom' line.

Safari battles go to BW2's engine with gen5/src/safari.c unchanged (HGSS's rules equal Platinum's). Bridge passes safariBalls, BASE_CATCH_RATE, BASE_GREAT_MARSH_RATE; returns balls left and BATTLE_OUTCOME_FOE_FLED. BALL/BAIT/ROCK labels added to the archive-11 copy in lib/port/gen5_rocket.c (MakeSafariButtons copied from Platinum's src/port/gen5_data.c; ROCKET_VERSION 5).

workflows.hgss_test: tools/docker/desktop.sh test tests/scripts/NAME.txt --from new-game  (test does not rebuild: build first)
workflows.hgss_apk: tools/docker/desktop.sh apk  (native macOS; VERSION_CODE from date and hour) then adb -s ADDR install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
workflows.platinum_build_test: cd ~/pokeplatinum-thor-ls && tools/docker/desktop.sh build && tools/docker/desktop.sh test tests/scripts/NAME.txt --from turtwig
workflows.platinum_apk: push platinum-thor; gh run download <id> -R teton-dev/pokeplatinum-thor-ls -n pokeplatinum-android
workflows.patch_bw2: Copy the pokebw2 file to scratch a/ and b/, apply the existing gen5/patches/<path>.patch to b/, edit b/, then 'diff -u --label a/PATH --label b/PATH a/PATH b/PATH > gen5/patches/PATH.patch'. A newly patched file moves from gen5/meson.build's base list into gen5_patched. Check no '+' lines were lost against git HEAD.
workflows.desktop_ui: tools/docker/desktop.sh start, then key/click/shot; the settings key is 'grave' (backquote); continue the saved game from the title with Return and z

gotchas: HGSS and Platinum name their save/bag/Pokemon APIs differently (GetMonData vs Pokemon_GetValue, PCStorage, PlayerProfile...); grep every API.
The decompilation's SPAWN_* constants don't match sSpawnPoints' order (spawn 5 is Cianwood); name warps from GetFlyWarpData's map.
Map object trainer ids: object types 1-8 with ScriptNumToTrainerNum(script).
HGSS GetMonData(MON_DATA_POKEBALL) returns a ball id (Apricorn 17-24); SetMonData/MonSetCatchData want an item id (492-499).
BW2's battle bag lists balls from archive 228 (a byte per item), not item data.
BW2 throw sprites stop at the Dream Ball; its ball particles cover all 25 balls.
gen5/include/gen5/port.h is force-included into every BW2 file: declare StrBuf-taking functions inside the patch that uses them.
Set Gen5Battle-derived flags at the start of Gen5_BattleBegin: the bag is filled before the rest.
At full HP no ball is a sure catch (even catch rate 255 Safari Ball ~1/2); tests use False Swipe + Spore or throw until caught.
BW2's move menu: the first pad press only shows the cursor; tests touch moves (FIGHT 128,95; move1 64,57; move2 191,57 in DS coords).
Falkner's birds use Sand-Attack; give test Pokemon Swift (firstmove 0 129).
HGSS flee rates differ from Platinum's: Chansey 90, Bulbasaur 0, Kangaskhan 150.
Mashing A with a Pokemon whose first move is a status move loses battles; set firstmove.
Desktop can't reach the Pokegear (desktop-only bug); use the Thor for Pokegear checks.
